summary: @servicetitan/hammer-token preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs fetches a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/...`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it (`execFileSync`) against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled CJS artifact (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) consisting of a large encoded numeric/string table decoded at runtime by an array-rotator + decoder pair; its behavior is not recoverable from the shipped form. The package's stated purpose is design-token / style-dictionary tooling and ships no native (C/C++/Rust) sources that would justify a second language runtime. Additional code under `src/utils/figma/get-token.js` combines `require('child_process')`, `require('fs')`, `require('http')`, `process.env` reads, and outbound POST/`fetch` calls. The alternate-runtime dropper chain executes opaque author-controlled bytes with the installing user's privileges on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
